quests.instruction: Can you find the one that is small protein-rich vegetables often served in a warm chili?
quests.question: Beans
quests.hint: They come in colors like red, black, and white.
quests.explanation: Great job! Beans is small protein-rich vegetables often served in a warm chili.
quests.funFact: There are hundreds of different kinds grown all around the world!

quests.instruction: Which one is a colorful vegetable shaped like a small bell or a tiny flame?
quests.question: Pepper
quests.hint: It comes in bright colors like red, yellow, and green.
quests.explanation: You got it! Pepper is a colorful vegetable shaped like a small bell or a tiny flame.
quests.funFact: This vegetable comes in almost every color of the rainbow!

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a small umbrella-shaped food that grows overnight after rain.
quests.question: Mushroom
quests.hint: It's often sliced onto a pizza or into a soup.
quests.explanation: Well done! Mushroom is a small umbrella-shaped food that grows overnight after rain.
quests.funFact: Certain wild kinds even glow softly in the dark!

quests.instruction: Point to the food that is tiny green vegetables often mixed into rice or stew.
quests.question: Peas
quests.hint: They often get mixed into rice or a warm stew.
quests.explanation: Correct! Peas is tiny green vegetables often mixed into rice or stew.
quests.funFact: They're actually seeds, not just a plain vegetable!

quests.instruction: Which food do you know that is a crunchy vegetable often stuffed or sliced into strips?
quests.question: Pepper
quests.hint: It's often sliced into crunchy strips for a snack.
quests.explanation: Super! Pepper is a crunchy vegetable often stuffed or sliced into strips.
quests.funFact: The spiciest kinds get their heat from a natural chemical called capsaicin!

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a long green vegetable with a cool, watery crunch.
quests.question: Cucumber
quests.hint: It's mostly water, which is why it feels so cool.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Cucumber is a long green vegetable with a cool, watery crunch.
quests.funFact: It's technically a fruit because it grows from a flower and has seeds!

quests.instruction: Point to the one that is small oval seeds cooked soft and served alongside rice.
quests.question: Beans
quests.hint: They're small, oval, and full of protein.
quests.explanation: You found it! Beans is small oval seeds cooked soft and served alongside rice.
quests.funFact: This food is a great source of protein, even without any meat!

quests.instruction: Can you find the food that is a hollow vegetable that can taste sweet or fiery hot?
quests.question: Pepper
quests.hint: Depending on the kind, it can taste sweet or very hot.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Pepper is a hollow vegetable that can taste sweet or fiery hot.
quests.funFact: Bell-shaped kinds are actually one of the sweetest vegetables around!

quests.instruction: Point to the one that is a leafy vegetable that shrinks down small when cooked.
quests.question: Spinach
quests.hint: It can be blended into a smoothie without changing the taste much.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Spinach is a leafy vegetable that shrinks down small when cooked.
quests.funFact: It's one of the best plant sources of iron for your body!

quests.instruction: Which food is a popular meat that can be baked, fried, or grilled?
quests.question: Chicken
quests.hint: It comes from a common farm bird, not a wild one.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Chicken is a popular meat that can be baked, fried, or grilled.
quests.funFact: It can be cooked in dozens of ways, from soup to nuggets!

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a round vegetable with layers that can make your eyes water.
quests.question: Onion
quests.hint: Chopping it can make some people's eyes water.
quests.explanation: Yes! Onion is a round vegetable with layers that can make your eyes water.
quests.funFact: Chopping this vegetable releases a gas that can make your eyes water!

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a vegetable many kids are told to finish before dessert.
quests.question: Broccoli
quests.hint: A little melted cheese makes this vegetable taste even better.
quests.explanation: That's right! Broccoli is a vegetable many kids are told to finish before dessert.
quests.funFact: This vegetable is closely related to cabbage and cauliflower!

quests.instruction: Which food is a vegetable that pops into a fluffy snack when heated?
quests.question: Corn
quests.hint: Heating certain kernels makes them pop into a fluffy snack.
quests.explanation: Great job! Corn is a vegetable that pops into a fluffy snack when heated.
quests.funFact: One stalk of this plant usually grows only one or two ears!

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a healthy food that swims and breathes through gills.
quests.question: Fish
quests.hint: It breathes using gills instead of lungs.
quests.explanation: You got it! Fish is a healthy food that swims and breathes through gills.
quests.funFact: There are more than 30,000 different kinds swimming in our waters!

quests.instruction: Point to the one that is a juicy red food used to make sauce and ketchup.
quests.question: Tomato
quests.hint: It grows on a vine, hanging like a little red lantern.
quests.explanation: Well done! Tomato is a juicy red food used to make sauce and ketchup.
quests.funFact: Even though we cook with it like a vegetable, this food is really a fruit!

quests.instruction: Point to the food that is little green vegetables that grow in a row inside a pod.
quests.question: Peas
quests.hint: They're bright green and about the size of a small marble.
quests.explanation: Correct! Peas is little green vegetables that grow in a row inside a pod.
quests.funFact: Farmers have grown this vegetable for thousands of years!

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a soft leafy green vegetable often mixed into a smoothie.
quests.question: Spinach
quests.hint: It shrinks down a lot when it's cooked.
quests.explanation: Super! Spinach is a soft leafy green vegetable often mixed into a smoothie.
quests.funFact: A famous cartoon sailor named Popeye made this vegetable extra famous!

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a spongy food often sliced onto pizza or into soup.
quests.question: Mushroom
quests.hint: Its shape looks a little like a tiny umbrella.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Mushroom is a spongy food often sliced onto pizza or into soup.
quests.funFact: This food isn't a plant at all — it's part of a different living kingdom called fungi!

quests.instruction: Which food do you know that is a green vegetable often steamed and topped with a little cheese?
quests.question: Broccoli
quests.hint: Its top is bumpy, and its stem is thick.
quests.explanation: You found it! Broccoli is a green vegetable often steamed and topped with a little cheese.
quests.funFact: It's packed with vitamins that help keep your body strong!

quests.instruction: Can you find the one that is a round red food often mistaken for a vegetable?
quests.question: Tomato
quests.hint: It's used to make both ketchup and pizza sauce.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Tomato is a round red food often mistaken for a vegetable.
quests.funFact: It comes in colors like yellow and purple, not just red!

quests.instruction: Can you find the one that is tiny round green vegetables that grow inside a pod?
quests.question: Peas
quests.hint: You pop them out of a long green pod.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Peas is tiny round green vegetables that grow inside a pod.
quests.funFact: A single pod can hold up to nine or ten of these tiny vegetables!

quests.instruction: Which food do you know that is a vegetable with juicy yellow kernels eaten right off the cob?
quests.question: Corn
quests.hint: Its kernels grow in neat rows along a cob.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Corn is a vegetable with juicy yellow kernels eaten right off the cob.
quests.funFact: It can be popped, boiled, grilled, or even ground into flour!

quests.instruction: Which food do you know that is a meat often shaped into nuggets for lunch?
quests.question: Chicken
quests.hint: It can be baked, fried, or grilled for dinner.
quests.explanation: Yes! Chicken is a meat often shaped into nuggets for lunch.
quests.funFact: This is one of the most popular meats eaten around the whole world!

quests.instruction: Can you find the one that is a cool crunchy vegetable that's mostly made of water?
quests.question: Cucumber
quests.hint: It's long, green, and very crunchy.
quests.explanation: That's right! Cucumber is a cool crunchy vegetable that's mostly made of water.
quests.funFact: This vegetable is about 95 percent water!

quests.instruction: Which food is a lean meat that comes from a common farm bird?
quests.question: Chicken
quests.hint: A drumstick is one popular way to serve this meat.
quests.explanation: Great job! Chicken is a lean meat that comes from a common farm bird.
quests.funFact: The bird it comes from can't fly very far at all!

quests.instruction: Which food do you know that is a green vegetable often sliced into salads or pickles?
quests.question: Cucumber
quests.hint: Soaking slices of it in vinegar turns it into pickles.
quests.explanation: You got it! Cucumber is a green vegetable often sliced into salads or pickles.
quests.funFact: Soaking it in a vinegar mixture is how pickles are made!

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a dark green leafy vegetable packed with iron.
quests.question: Spinach
quests.hint: It's dark green, leafy, and full of iron.
quests.explanation: Well done! Spinach is a dark green leafy vegetable packed with iron.
quests.funFact: This leafy green shrinks to a small fraction of its size when cooked!

quests.instruction: Can you find the one that is a vegetable with a strong smell, sliced into rings for burgers?
quests.question: Onion
quests.hint: It has layers, like the pages of a book.
quests.explanation: Correct! Onion is a vegetable with a strong smell, sliced into rings for burgers.
quests.funFact: People have grown and eaten it for over 5,000 years!

quests.instruction: Which one is small round vegetables that roll right off your fork?
quests.question: Peas
quests.hint: Several of them grow in a neat row inside one pod.
quests.explanation: Super! Peas is small round vegetables that roll right off your fork.
quests.funFact: They're actually seeds, not just a plain vegetable!

quests.instruction: Which one is a food that isn't a plant, animal, or vegetable at all?
quests.question: Mushroom
quests.hint: It doesn't need sunlight the way plants do.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Mushroom is a food that isn't a plant, animal, or vegetable at all.
quests.funFact: Some kinds can spring up overnight after just a little rain!
